text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the
shopping
district, I come across El
Condor Pasa holding her
head in her
hands.
Ah, Trainer! Great timing!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm actually competing against these old

documents right now!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Sí! I'm on cooking duty today, so I went
into the
kitchen...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
And there, I found a "secret recipe"
stuck
between the shelves!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It's just like an ancient text! It's even
missing some
words here and there, like
a puzzle!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Yup! I'm certain this is some kind of
challenge left
behind by the Miho
Dormitory students that came
before
me.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I have her show me this "ancient text."

There's some obvious damage to the
document,
but it's clear at a glance that
this is a recipe for
curry.

That's what they want you to think! I
thought so
too when I first read it!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
But there's no way students of old would
leave
behind such an easy challenge!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It's like in the game I was playing the
other day,
where chest right next to the
door turned out to
be a mimic! I won't
be fooled so easily again!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure there's some secret in the
missing parts of
the recipe!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: I think it's just been nibbled at by bugs.

text_block_list.text:
No way! I'm sure it was hidden on
purpose!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Like this missing part right here—I think
there
could be more to it!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Judging by how it's written, this here
should be
read as...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
"Extremo!" The students from before are
telling us
this is the ultimate ingredient!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: I think you're reading too much into it.

text_block_list.text:
No way! I can't beat this challenge
thinking like
that! If I'm gonna win, I
gotta read between the
lines!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: All right! Now this blank spot must be...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
A secret spicy seasoning that I haven't
seen
before.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the challenge, El Condor
Pasa
continues purchasing ingredients
based on her
own interpretations of the
paper.

Perfect! I've got everything I need for
victory!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
As long as everyone enjoys it, it'll be a
total
success!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Oh, El, you're with your trainer. You had
me
worried, getting back so late.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: So, did you buy the ingredients?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: You betcha! I found everything!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
She tells Грасс Вандер in detail about
the old
document, the "secret recipe,"
and how she
solved the mystery.

No matter how you look at it, this recipe
sure
seems a lot like curry...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
You're being naive too, Grass! It's a trap!
We
can't win if we take it at face value!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Hmm... But El, if you want to call this a complete victory, don't you need to make something that everyone at the dorm can enjoy?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Sí! Naturally!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
With all these insanely spicy ingredients,
I don't
know if anyone is even going to
be able to eat
it...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Qué?! B-but...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: This is terrible! I gotta do something!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: Let's make a new batch with everyone in mind!
We could try to sweeten it up with some sugar.

text_block_list.text:
Great idea! We still have time! Let's get
some
ingredients for regular curry!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess the mystery game is over!
Now...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: It's time for a race! I still haven't lost yet!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You're always giving your all, for
better or
for worse.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: I see! That just might work!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I really don't think it will...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Come now, let's go buy some normal
ingredients.
I'll even help you out.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Ah, uh... okay...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
And so, Эль Кондор Паса heads out once
again,
this time with Грасс Вандер, to
buy new
ingredients.

After that, Эль Кондор Паса buys some
normal
curry ingredients to secure a
victory.
